set system host-name CE1.explanation: Configure the host name of the device.

parameters.name: hostname
parameters.explanation: The host name of the equipment is used to identify the equipment in the network.

set protocols oam cfm version 1.explanation: Configure the version of the CFM protocol.

set protocols oam cfm maintenance-domain.explanation: The command configures a Connectivity Fault Management (CFM) maintenance domain named `[parameter1]` in Junos for monitoring and troubleshooting Ethernet networks.

parameters.name: maintenance-domain
parameters.explanation: Maintains the name of the domain.

level 6.explanation: The command `level [parameter2]` in Junos sets the logging severity level for system messages, where `[parameter2]` specifies the desired severity level (e.g., `error`, `warning`).

maintenance-association ma2.explanation: The command `maintenance-association [parameter2]` in Junos configures a Maintenance Association (MA) for Ethernet OAM, where `[parameter2]` specifies the MA name or identifier.

parameters.name: maintenance-association
parameters.explanation: Maintains the name of the association.

mep 61.explanation: The command `mep [parameter3]` in Junos configures a Maintenance End Point (MEP) for Ethernet OAM, where `[parameter3]` specifies the MEP identifier.

interface ge-1/0/1.explanation: The command `interface [parameter4]` in Junos enters configuration mode for the specified network interface identified by `[parameter4]`.

parameters.name: interface
parameters.explanation: Name of interface associated with MEP.

ccm-interval 10.explanation: The `ccm-interval [parameter4]` command in Junos sets the interval for Continuity Check Messages (CCMs) in Ethernet OAM, where `[parameter4]` specifies the time interval in milliseconds.

parameters.name: ccm-interval
parameters.explanation: CCM message sent interval in milliseconds.

remote-mep 62.explanation: The command `remote-mep [parameter3]` in Junos configures a remote Maintenance End Point (MEP) for Ethernet OAM, specifying the MEP ID for connectivity monitoring.

cross-connect mpls.explanation: The command `cross-connect [parameter4]` in Junos creates a logical connection between two interfaces or circuits, enabling direct data forwarding without routing.

ais.explanation: The `ais` command in Junos enables Alarm Indication Signal (AIS) generation on a specific interface to notify downstream devices of a fault upstream.

ais suppress-alarms.explanation: The command `ais suppress-alarms` in Junos disables the generation of Alarm Indication Signal (AIS) alarms on the specified interface or circuit.

unit 0.explanation: Configure the unit number of the interface.

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: Interface unit numbers that distinguish between multiple logical configurations under the same interface.

family ethernet-switching interface-mode.explanation: Configures the interface with trunk exchange mode.

family ethernet-switching vlan members 1.explanation: Configure the VLAN members of the interface.
